Chapter 6090: Greatest Mortal

Chapter 6090: Greatest Mortal

“He’s the one with all the miraculous feats?” Most were skeptical while looking at him.

“Yes.” A believer who watched everything said: “He entered the immortal city in Splendor Terra, beating everyone using a strange statue. And, he gave Six-sense Ancestor’s weapon to Final Desolate God just a while back.”

“A mortal did all of this? That’s hard to believe.” Listeners nearby didn’t buy it.

“Is he trying to enter the abyssal well?” One big shot asked.

“Perhaps he can endure the tribulation in the plains.” The believer in Li Qiye said.

“Is that a joke? The well contains so much lightning affinity, no one here can handle it, let alone a mortal.” Others said skeptically.

“One wave alone will turn them to ashes.” The crowd had a near-unanimous consensus.

“Hey! That’s the abyssal well, a container of endless lightning water, it will destroy you if you get close even before Heavenly Wrath’s emergence, run!” A kind big shot shouted at them.

Li Qiye glanced at him and smiled.

“Did you hear that, leave already!” The big shot repeated.

“It’s fine.” Li Qiye waved in response, leaving the big shot speechless.

Others shook their head after seeing his continual trek toward the well.

“Let him die if that is his wish.” One of them said.

“A mortal afflicted by ignorance knows not of the lightning water’s potency. I wonder if he is aware of what a tribulation is.” One ancestor said.

“Those who are fearless only realize the immensity of heaven and earth when death comes knocking. Let him bear the consequence.” An expert sneered.

Dragonform Emperor frowned since Li Qiye was taking Six-style with him.

“So this is the greatest mortal.” The apex emperors knew about Li Qiye’s tales and just like the rest, they also activated their heavenly gaze to assess Li Qiye. They came to the same conclusion - he was just an ordinary mortal.

“Crackle!” Lightning bolts surged out of the well once they drew near.

Strangely enough, they didn’t attack Li Qiye but seemingly observed him with curiosity.

“Now’s the time to run! You will die for sure!” The big shot earlier warned him again.

“I won’t.” Li Qiye chuckled.

“Is that so?” Ouyang Dragon God became gigantic and looked down at Li Qiye. His shadow engulfed the target.

Li Qiye didn’t bat an eye, only focusing on the lightning bolts coming out of the well.

“Brat, you will die in my hands.” Ouyang Dragon God declared with chilling intent.

Others exchanged glances; they didn’t understand the feud between the two but thought a desolate god would have no issue killing a mortal.

“But first, I will torture you.” Ouyang Dragon God viewed Li Qiye’s indifference as further humiliation.

“Clank!” An energy arc surged through the area and left a long afterimage, leaving through everything along the way.

This strike was ruthless and caused the dragon god to roar and hastily conjure a defensive seal.

“Boom!” The seal was cleaved through, leaving the defender exposed.

Blood splattered on the ground as the dragon god staggered backward, wounded.

The remnant sword energy left the spectators breathless.

“You think too highly of your clan. Since when do you dare to flaunt your power before our dynasty?” A white-haired emperor hovered in the air and said arrogantly.

“Disaster Emperor!” Others shouted his title.

“Disaster!” Ouyang Dragon God was furious after losing the first exchange in public.

Disaster’s sword intent was piercing. Anyone could see his willingness to fight. The apex emperors nearby considered him a capable opponent due to his sword skills. His cultivation was lower due to his age but one day, he could surpass the apex level.

A half-step emperor was simply stronger than a desolate god at the stately level.

“Disaster, there is no need to bring our dynasty into this.” Dragonform frowned and said.

Listeners understood because although Dragonform was a member of Enigma, the dragon god was his younger brother. Which side would he pick in this scenario?

Moreover, they wondered about Li Qiye’s relation to Enigma.

“Brother Dragonform, as an emperor of Enigma, you should respect Enigma Loops. If you do not wish to do so, you should just return to the Ouyang Clan since your post appears to be all but in name.” Disaster uttered coldly.

“Disaster, this is not the place to talk.” Dragonform said.

“Enigma Loops?” Others exchanged glances.

Witch King, Golden Flower, and the others knew little about Enigma Loops. Nevertheless, they took a good look at the bracelets on Li Qiye’s arm.

Dragonform turned red, clearly annoyed after hearing this.
